question.text: An option that has zero intrinsic value and the underlying price equals the strike price is termed as:

explanation.text: The Logic: When Underlying = Strike, the option is ATM. It has zero intrinsic value (like OTM) but is at the boundary between ITM and OTM. The Trap: OTM also has zero intrinsic value, but the underlying does not equal the strike -- it is on the wrong side. ITM has positive intrinsic value. Cross-Exam Context: Moneyness classification is a fundamental concept tested across all NISM derivative modules.
